questions.whatTheAgentLoses: You lose the immediate reassurance of seeing the payment confirmation yourself and the opportunity to personally record the transaction reference number for your records.

questions.question: Did the payment succeed, what was the final charged amount, and when can you download your e-Card?

questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The user misses the confirmation of their payment, the exact amount charged, and the timeline for receiving their actual insurance card.

questions.question: Did your submission succeed, and what must you click to continue?
questions.why: The Benefits Alerts modal confirms your selections were successfully submitted to UCPath and instructs you to click Done to proceed to your submission statement.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: Delegating this step means you miss the direct confirmation that your benefits were successfully submitted and the instructions on when to expect the final confirmation email.

questions.question: Does the enrollment success message make sense given you never uploaded the mandatory documents or clicked save?
questions.why: A success message appeared at the bottom of the screen even though the mandatory document fields still showed 'No file chosen', which could mean the application is actually incomplete.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: You lose the ability to verify if your application was truly submitted with all required documentation or if the system falsely reported success.

questions.question: Is the redirect link to pay your first month's premium (binder payment) broken or missing from the confirmation page?
questions.why: On ACA exchanges, coverage doesn't start until the first premium is paid, but the redirect to the insurer's payment portal often fails or is delayed.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The agent might think the task is done at the exchange confirmation screen, causing your coverage to be canceled for non-payment before it even starts.

questions.question: Does the confirmation screen show a coverage effective date that is later than you expected?
questions.why: Depending on the exact date you enroll (e.g., after the 15th of the month), your coverage might start a month later than anticipated.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: An agent might complete the enrollment without alerting you to a gap in coverage, leaving you uninsured for an entire month.

questions.question: Do you want to review your submitted enrollment details and note the deadline for changes?

questions.whatTheAgentLoses: You lose the opportunity to personally verify that your final enrollment details are correct and to note the exact deadline for future modifications.

questions.question: Do you want to print the enrollment summary for your records before navigating away?

questions.whatTheAgentLoses: You lose the opportunity to decide whether to keep a printed or saved digital copy of the final enrollment summary for your personal records.

questions.question: How and by when can you cancel or change this plan before it takes effect?

questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The user loses the awareness of their exact window to reverse the decision and the specific steps required to cancel the policy before being locked in.
